Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the forces acting on the object at the initiation of sliding are balanced, which is not the correct interpretation of the problem. The object starts to slide due to an unbalanced force overcoming static friction, causing acceleration. This error stems from misinterpreting the physics of motion initiation and incorrectly associating the balanced force condition with the onset of sliding, leading to the selection of the wrong answer (A instead of B).
